description: wire-cases.json#http-403 — an UNSEEDED key (#918): payload null (absent from KV) and no fault, so the upstream answers its own unknown-key miss, the reference origin's 403 AccessDenied XML (application/xml), which the read-path transcript binds to the CDN Worker.
